review_candidates.title: Project Director
review_candidates.description: About Us Macquarie Data Centres are Australia's most experienced Data Centre Provider and experts in seriously secure, sovereign and compliant data centres. Our AI and cloud data centres are trusted by the world’s biggest hyperscalers, Global Fortune 500 companies and 42% of the Australian Federal Government. All our campuses are Certified Strategic by the Australian Federal Government and backed by a highly experienced cohort of government cleared engineers. We are an owned by the ASX listed Macquarie Technology Group. Step into one of Australia’s most secure, high-performance Data Centres and launch your engineering career supporting mission-critical infrastructure for cloud, defence and enterprise customers. The Opportunity At Macquarie Data Centres, we don't just build data centres—we deliver the critical infrastructure that powers Australia's digital economy. We're looking for an experienced Project Director to lead the delivery of some of Australia's most significant mission-critical infrastructure projects. Reporting to the Executive General Manager you'll take ownership of a portfolio of major capital programs, from design and construction through to commissioning and operational readiness. This is a highly visible leadership role where you'll work alongside hyperscale customers, executive stakeholders, consultants and delivery partners to ensure complex, multi-million-dollar projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to the highest quality standards. Beyond project delivery, you'll play a key role in shaping and maturing our Project Management Office (PMO), strengthening governance, reporting and delivery frameworks that will support the continued growth of our Data Centre business. If you're passionate about delivering world-class infrastructure, thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy leading high-performing teams through complex challenges, we'd love to hear from you. Why Us? We're Great Place to Work Certified 2023, 2024 and 2025. Australia's #1 Great Place To Work in Technology, 2026. For the third year in a row, we have been named a Global Winner of the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award! We have the highest Net Promoter Score on the ASX, the World's best customer experience & crowned in 2020 at the World Communications Awards . You’ll make an impact Enjoy being part of a driven team with a collaborative culture that values decision-makers and action. We Invest in you Accelerate your career through our learning and development opportunities - think Gallup strengths-based training, defined career pathways and fantastic internal mobility opportunities across the group. About You Extensive experience leading major capital infrastructure projects within data centres or other mission-critical environments (essential) A proven track record delivering complex projects from concept through to commissioning and operational handover. Strong commercial acumen with experience managing multi-million-dollar budgets, forecasting and financial reporting. Experienced in building trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, customers, contractors and consultants. A proven track record delivering a quality outcome on time and on budget. Confident leading multidisciplinary teams while influencing outcomes across matrix environments. Passionate about developing project governance, improving delivery frameworks and driving operational excellence. Calm under pressure with exceptional organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities. Customer-focused with a collaborative leadership style and a commitment to delivering exceptional outcomes. Comfortable working in a fast-growing, agile business where no two projects are the same. Required Skills Extensive experience delivering major data centre, critical infrastructure or large-scale construction projects. Senior Program or Project Management experience across large capital investment portfolios. Degree in Electrical, Mechanical or Civil Engineering, Project Management or Construction Management (or equivalent). Strong knowledge of project governance, risk management, scheduling and stage-gate delivery methodologies. Experience managing project commercials including budgeting, forecasting and financial controls. Demonstrated contract negotiation and supplier management experience. Strong understanding of mission-critical infrastructure including power, cooling, MEP systems and commissioning. Experience working with enterprise, wholesale or hyperscale customers. Knowledge of Uptime Institute Tier Standards, TIA-942 and data centre best practice (highly regarded). PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent Project Management certification (desirable). Proven leadership capability with the ability to coach, mentor and build high-performing project teams. Outstanding communication and executive stakeholder management skills. If this excites you, apply now , we'd love to hear from you! We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.title: Customer Technical Project Manager
review_candidates.description: CAPGEMINI ENGINEERING At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same. YOUR ROLE Manage complex telecommunications projects with full end-to-end accountability for delivery, integration and customer acceptance. Plan, coordinate and govern production deployments across multiple environments, ensuring alignment between project and operational teams. Lead daily deployment readiness and coordination forums to align activities, dependencies, risks and deployment schedules. Act as the primary point of contact for customer stakeholders, managing expectations and ensuring delivery priorities are aligned. Collaborate with customers to identify project objectives, define priorities and support network transformation initiatives. Lead technical workstreams including Analysis & Design, Integration, Verification and Validation activities. Ensure successful solution integration, testing, deployment and acceptance according to contractual commitments and project scope. Coordinate the resolution of technical issues, production incidents and deployment challenges with engineering and operations teams. Establish and align operational support processes to ensure solution stability and long-term service continuity. Contribute to pre-sales activities by supporting solution scoping, estimation, delivery planning and risk assessment. Lead technical discussions and negotiations while driving execution across multiple project streams and stakeholders. Ensure project governance, quality standards and KPIs are achieved throughout the project lifecycle. Identify risks proactively and implement mitigation plans to support successful project outcomes. Advise customers on network evolution opportunities and contribute to service expansion and project growth initiatives. Document project decisions, deployment plans, governance processes and technical delivery frameworks. YOUR PROFILE Degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline. Minimum of 7 years of experience managing complex, cross-domain technical projects. Proven experience delivering projects within Telecom Core Networks, Cloud and Data Center environments. Strong experience leading production deployments, migrations and large-scale transformation initiatives. Experience managing customer-facing projects with end-to-end delivery accountability. Proven experience supporting pre-sales activities, including solution scoping, estimation and risk management. Strong understanding of system engineering, integration methodologies and solution lifecycle management. Experience with configuration management and change management processes. Good knowledge of telecom operator environments, business models and technology drivers. Understanding of cloud-native architectures and modern infrastructure environments. Ability to coordinate multiple technical teams, stakeholders and third-party vendors. Strong leadership, project management and decision-making skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage risks and priorities effectively. Self-driven mindset with the ability to work independently and deliver results with minimal supervision. Fluent English. What You’ll Love About Working Here Join a multicultural and inclusive team environment. Enjoy a supportive atmosphere promoting work life balance. Hybrid work. Your career growth is central to our mission. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professionals are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities. Access valuable training and certifications in cutting edge technologies. Engage in exciting national and international projects. Health and life insurance. Referral program with bonuses for talent recommendations. Great office locations. About Capgemini Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology, and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations.

review_candidates.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
review_candidates.description: First Tech is a technology company focused on building, scaling, and delivering innovative digital platforms across financial services and other industries. We combine technology, product expertise, and a deep understanding of customer needs to create solutions that simplify complex processes and deliver seamless digital experiences. Our platforms are designed to be scalable, reliable, and impactful, helping businesses and customers navigate the evolving digital landscape with confidence. Founded with a vision to accelerate digital transformation, First Tech brings together strong engineering capabilities, product development expertise, and a culture of innovation to build modern solutions that address real-world challenges. By partnering with forward-thinking businesses and developing technology-driven products, we aim to reshape industries and improve everyday experiences. We believe in creating an inclusive, collaborative environment where talented individuals are empowered to innovate, grow, and make a meaningful impact. What You'll Do Define and drive quality strategy across the entire product development lifecycle. Partner with Product Managers and Engineers to embed quality into every stage of development. Leverage AI-powered testing tools to accelerate test design, automation, and defect analysis while ensuring comprehensive test coverage. Design, review, and maintain automated and manual test cases based on functional and non-functional requirements. Plan and execute functional, regression, integration, performance, and usability testing. Validate AI-generated test cases, automation scripts, and testing outcomes to ensure accuracy, reliability, and coverage. Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects through resolution, working closely with engineering teams. Continuously improve test automation frameworks, quality processes, and release readiness. Analyze product quality metrics and provide actionable insights to improve product reliability and user experience. Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment to ensure timely, high-quality feature delivery. Mentor QA team members and promote engineering excellence, quality best practices, and AI-driven testing methodologies. Continuously evaluate emerging AI tools, testing frameworks, and industry best practices to improve team productivity and software quality. Produce and maintain clear test documentation, quality standards, and testing procedures. Take ownership of product quality from feature planning through production release and post-release validation. What We're Looking For Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. 4-8 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance or Quality Engineering. Experience working in an AI-assisted testing environment using modern AI-powered QA and automation tools. Strong ability to review, validate, and refine AI-generated test cases, automation scripts, and test results. Experience designing and executing manual and automated testing for web and mobile applications (iOS and Android). Solid understanding of functional, regression, integration, performance, and API testing. Experience with SQL Server (MS SQL) for data validation and backend testing. Experience with test automation frameworks such as Selenium, Appium, Playwright, or equivalent tools is an advantage. Familiarity with REST APIs and API testing tools (e.g., Postman or equivalent). Proficiency with Git, GitHub, Jira, and Agile development methodologies. Basic knowledge of .NET applications and software development practices is a plus. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams. Passion for leveraging AI to improve testing efficiency, product quality, and engineering productivity. Working Model: 5 days in office Location: Nasr City So, what does it really mean to work at First.Tech? We are building a company where people are empowered to do their best work and grow. Our culture is rooted in ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning. As part of First Tech, you will be working in an environment that values innovation, speed, and impact, while giving you the opportunity to shape products that directly affect how people experience financial services. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome people from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply if this role excites you.

Develop and update course materials and curricula, integrating current technical, procedural, and regulatory requirements to maintain relevance and effectiveness. Compile examination questions and maintain records to support the examination and certification process in collaboration with the Examination Manager. Strong public speaking skills with the ability to engage and motivate diverse audiences. Advanced English language skills (written and spoken). Excellent organizational and time management capabilities. Ability and willingness to travel when required.

review_candidates.description: Rattaché(e) au Responsable du dossier de délivrabilité et au Directeur des Opérations, vous jouerez un rôle pivot au sein du Pôle Délivrabilité. Votre mission consiste à allier le secrétariat classique de direction à la gestion opérationnelle de la relation client, tout en assurant un contrôle qualité rigoureux des données et une présence active sur les réseaux sociaux. C'est un poste polyvalent exigeant une grande agilité entre tâches administratives, support technique et missions de terrain. Missions Gestion des processus de délivrabilité : contrôle qualité des informations clients, compilation des dossiers conformes et appui logistique au Responsable. Relation client (Front Office) : accueil téléphonique et traitement des emails, réponse de premier niveau et orientation vers les experts. Pilotage éditorial : programmation des contenus marketing sur les réseaux sociaux (LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, etc.) et vérification systématique des publications. Secrétariat de direction : gestion d'agenda, rédaction de correspondances professionnelles et élaboration de comptes-rendus de réunions. Gestion des commissions : exécution de déplacements professionnels (dépôt/retrait de documents ou colis), contrôle de conformité, suivi et reporting associé. Profil recherché Formation Bac+2 minimum (avec une première expérience réussie en support client, assistanat ou gestion de contenus, fortement apprécié). Maîtrise des outils collaboratifs et bureautiques (Trello, Word, Google Docs/Sheets,etc.). Excellente aisance rédactionnelle et orthographe irréprochable. Bilinguisme Français / Anglais fortement apprécié (écrit et oral). Sens aigu du service client, diplomatie et excellente posture relationnelle. Grande rigueur administrative, sens des priorités et capacité à gérer des imprévus de manière autonome. Fiabilité, discrétion et ponctualité exemplaire.
